entries.mechanism: EUROMOD BE_2025 tinfe_be computes the refundable Article 289ter/1 low-wage work-bonus tax credit from the pre-cap scheduled i_tsceerdA_s and i_tsceerdB_s amounts, while CIR 92 Article 289ter/1 bases the credit on the work-bonus reductions actually granted, so the source-backed RuleSpec caps the A/B credit bases by the Article 38 personal contribution before reductions. Only the 10k low-wage case is affected; the 30k and 60k worker PIT control cases match within tolerance.
